methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked. Bodyless GET -> 500 'Internal error' (req.json throws); any method with JSON body behaves like POST.

auth.notes: Auth first; then body; then ownership (403).

request.parse: Destructures {deckId, retryOnly} from await req.json() (retry.ts:9-12). Malformed JSON -> 500 'Internal error'. JSON null -> TypeError on destructuring -> 500 'Internal error'.

fields.name: deckId
fields.bounds: must be a UUID in practice: a non-UUID reaches Postgres in ownsDeck and the type error surfaces as 500 'Internal error'

fields.name: retryOnly
fields.validation: !Array.isArray -> 400 'deckId and retryOnly required'. Elements passed verbatim to the background, which regenerates slides where retryOnly.includes(slide.number) (_shared/generateCore.ts:128). Non-number elements (e.g. {number, variant}) silently match nothing.

checkOrder: 7. triggerBackground({deckId, userId, brandId, language, slides:[{number, prompt, type}], retryOnly}) — failures swallowed

errors.when: deckId falsy or retryOnly not an array
deck not owned by caller or does not exist
malformed/null JSON, non-UUID deckId, DB errors

sideEffects: Background trigger; the background overlays the prior job state, keeps the deck's original masterUsed decision and regenerates only listed slides (_shared/generateCore.ts:108-130)
externalCalls: Supabase; background OpenAI image generation — PAID
quirks: Unlike /api/refine, retry does NOT pre-mark slides 'generating' in the job state, so the first /api/status poll after the 202 can still report done:true (frontend calls restart() on the poller; src/lib/useDeckStatus.ts:5-10).
retryOnly:[] is accepted: deck status flips to 'generating' but nothing is regenerated (empty array is truthy in generateCore.ts:108 and wanted() matches nothing).
Not counted against any cap; brandId and language are recovered from decks.inputs, not the request (_shared/db.ts:461-478).
Slide types are re-attached from the persisted storyline (types[s.number] may be undefined) (retry.ts:25).
beforeAnyState: A non-existent deck -> 403 'Not your deck' (indistinguishable from foreign).

tests.asserts: 202; trigger arg deckId, retryOnly passed verbatim (test uses [{number:2, variant:'B'}] objects, legacy shape), slides from prompts, setDeckStatus 'generating'; type re-attached; 403 non-owner; brandId and language recovered (lines 24-71). Passing as of 2026-10-08.

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:847-879 — matches (retryOnly integer[], 202 DeckJobResponse). DeckJobResponse lists `warnings`, which retry never returns. No 400/403 documented.
